d.title: .hack//Tasogare no Udewa Densetsu: Offline de Aimashou
d.en: .hack//Legend of the Twilight Offline Meeting Special
d.jp: .hack//黄昏の腕輪伝説 オフラインで会いましょう
d.synopsis: It's a short story about the characters from .hack// Legend of the Twilight meeting offline. It's more to hear than to see. It shows only backgrounds from the real world with the heads of the charater-game-avatars; but it reveals some interesting real life informations about the characters.
